svg.title: FARTland // Fluid · compact notch
svg.desc: An edge-attached notch with only the clock at rest. While music plays, the notch adds a track and waveform. Controls appear on hover.
svg.text: Clock at rest. Track and waveform during playback. Controls on hover.
POWER / NETWORK / INBOX / BATTERY / STATUS / TRAY
A short spring on open and close. The waveform moves while music plays.
